tiles.descriptionOverride: Can a piece of taro catch a thief? At this shrine in Moulvibazar, folklore says crushing one between two bricks can make stolen goods come back.

A mythical flower said to cure any illness. A journey through strange kingdoms, monstrous serpents, and a princess who devours humans. Prince Firoz Shah will risk everything to find the legendary Gul-e-Deogandha. But the flower holds a terrible secret—and some miracles come at a price far greater than anyone imagines.
